Draw a gtable, labeling and putting a border around every non-zero grob

Source: R/gtable-show-grobs.R
gtable_show_grobs.Rd

Draw a gtable, labeling and putting a border around every non-zero grob

Usage

gtable_show_grobs(
  x,
  color = "red",
  fill = "#80FFFF66",
  fontsize = 12,
  labels = TRUE,
  show_zeroGrobs = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

A gtable object. Or a ggplot or patchwork object, which will be converted to a gtable, provided those packages are available.

color

Color for grob names and border outlines.

fill

Fill color for borders. Semi-transparent colors work well.

fontsize

Size for grob names.

labels

Either TRUE/FALSE for whether to print the grob names, or a regex such that only grob names matching the regex will be printed.

show_zeroGrobs

TRUE/FALSE for whether to show zeroGrobs.

See also

gtable_print()
